faq.question: What types of scholarships are available for first-generation students in Massachusetts?
faq.answer: There are currently five scholarships listed specifically for first-generation students in Massachusetts. These opportunities cover various fields, including STEM, Biology, and Education, providing a range of options depending on your area of interest.

faq.question: How can I find out the specific deadlines for these scholarships?
faq.answer: Each scholarship has its own deadline, so it's important to check the details for each listing. At least one scholarship has a deadline approaching within the next 45 days, so reviewing the listings promptly is advisable.

faq.question: Do I need to write an essay to apply for these scholarships?
faq.answer: Most of the scholarships listed do not require an essay, but it's best to verify each individual listing for specific requirements. Generally, many of the scholarships in this category have lighter application requirements.

faq.question: What are the award amounts for these scholarships?
